clauses.heading: Position
clauses.text: The Employee is employed as a Customer Support Agent in the Company's Baku contact centre.

clauses.heading: Term
clauses.text: This contract is for an indefinite term starting on 3 June 2024.

clauses.heading: Working hours
clauses.text: The Employee shall work forty (40) hours per week on a rota between 08:00 and 20:00, Monday to Saturday.

clauses.heading: Overtime
clauses.text: Overtime requested by the Company shall be paid at one and a half times the hourly rate.

clauses.heading: Salary
clauses.text: The Employee's gross monthly salary is AZN 1,100.

clauses.heading: Annual leave
clauses.text: The Employee is entitled to twenty-one (21) calendar days of paid annual leave per year.

clauses.heading: Sick leave
clauses.text: The Employee is entitled to up to seven (7) days of sick leave per calendar year at full pay.

clauses.heading: Notice
clauses.text: Either party may terminate this contract by giving thirty (30) days' written notice.
